chapter: Road life, race and Woody Herman/Tommy Dorsey
title: Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey's personalities
summary: The Dorsey brothers fought and died young.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: These guys had their distinct personalities, didn’t they?

Oh yeah. He and his brother used to have fist fights. Imagine that? Over music? It doesn’t make any sense to me. But unfortunately they died before their time. Both those guys. Tommy and Jimmy died young. They died in their early 50s or whatever it was. The bands were dying but they shouldn’t have gone that soon. But I guess you can’t drink all that booze and not have something—
